body:
The **Dhaka scene roundup** for 22 September 2026 came with two questions. The first is the series staple: "Which one did you miss last week?" The second turns to us: readers were asked to comment on "which one we failed to capture on our radar this week."

## What's in the 22 September Dhaka scene roundup

The events themselves are on the slides of the original Instagram post. The cover is in the series' style, with the B-POP Tags logo over a warm brown gradient, "DHAKA" in giant glowing letters and an illustrated woman in orange tones with her face turned to the sky, apartment blocks below.

## A radar that admits its blind spots

Asking what we missed is deliberate. Dhaka's independent scene runs on word of mouth, and a lot happens in rooms that never make it onto a poster. The comment section works as a correction log: every name someone adds is a crew or venue we can follow from then on.

Two days earlier we posted [Dhaka events to save for September 2026](post:dhaka-events-to-save-september-2026), so this roundup is partly its follow-up. For neighbouring weeks, see the [9 September roundup](post:dhaka-scene-roundup-9-september-2026) and the [6 October roundup](post:dhaka-scene-roundup-6-october-2026). All of them sit on our [events and radar hub](topic:events), and the rest of the magazine is on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdmGfb8GlVm/)

faq.q: What is the B-POP Tags weekly radar?
faq.a: It's B-POP Tags' recurring roundup of Dhaka's scene on Instagram. This edition asked which events readers missed last week and which ones the radar failed to capture.

faq.q: How do I suggest an event for the radar?
faq.a: Comment on the original Instagram post. The caption invites readers to name events B-POP Tags didn't capture.
